propositions: git archive subprocess in snapshot_at_ref has no timeout parameter and can stall indefinitely when child process blocks on network operations like lazy-fetch to unresponsive promisor remote
undrained stderr pipe causes deadlock when child writes more than ~64 KiB to stderr while parent reads stdout, blocking both processes
stdin is inherited instead of set to DEVNULL, allowing credential or host-key prompts to block the snapshot call
TimeoutExpired exception raised by subprocess can leak credential-bearing command-line arguments into error messages if not redacted through module error conversion
snapshot_at_ref must properly drain stderr on a separate thread while reading stdout to prevent classic pipe deadlock
stalled subprocess must be bounded by wall-clock timeout with stall-abort detection and credential redaction on any timeout error
